description: This file defines the class CubeRenderer that implements the GLSurfaceView.Renderer interface to render animated 3D cubes using OpenGL ES in Android.

classes.name: CubeRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class that draws tumbling 3D cubes with OpenGL ES on Android.

methods.name: CubeRenderer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the renderer with a translucent background option.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Draws a frame of the scene, rendering the cubes and updating rotation angle.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts the viewport and projection matrix when the surface size changes.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL ES features and sets clear color based on background translucency.
